# superset_saved_query (Data Source)

Looks up a saved query of SQL Lab by its label, for example to reuse its SQL in a virtual dataset or in `superset_sql_query`. Labels are not unique in Superset: the lookup fails when no saved query matches, or when several do.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "superset_saved_query" "top_customers" {
  label = "Top customers"
}

resource "superset_dataset" "top_customers" {
  database_name = data.superset_saved_query.top_customers.database_name
  table_name    = "top_customers"
  schema        = data.superset_saved_query.top_customers.schema
  sql           = data.superset_saved_query.top_customers.sql
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `label` (String) Label of the saved query. The comparison is exact.

### Optional

- `database_id` (Number) Identifier of the database connection of the query. Set it when several saved queries share the label.

### Read-Only

- `catalog` (String) Catalog the query runs in, on Superset 4.1 and later; null when none is set.
- `database_name` (String) Name of the database connection of the query.
- `description` (String) Description of the query.
- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the saved query.
- `schema` (String) Schema the query runs in; null when none is set.
- `sql` (String) SQL of the query.
